blackNet.name: BLACK SHEEP NET
blackNet.description: Web monorepo with Next.js and a PHP API on top of Firebird and Microsip, in production. It includes a route planner built with Leaflet and OpenStreetMap, visit ordering with OSRM (exact Dijkstra up to 10 stops; nearest neighbor with 2-opt for longer routes), Google geocoding, orders scheduled through cron, and deployment on IIS and PM2.
blackNet.summary: Field sales CRM synced with the Microsip ERP: route planner with a map (OSRM), quotes, orders and payments. Web and iOS/Android app, multi-company.

aerial.name: Aerial Depot WMS
aerial.description: Warehouse management system (WMS) with separate back end and front end: a Laravel 12 API with JWT authentication, a MySQL database with migrations and seed data, product images processed with GD, and a Vue 3 interface that shows the warehouse in 3D with Three.js to locate products.
aerial.summary: Warehouse management system (WMS): Laravel 12 API with JWT, MySQL and a Vue 3 interface with the warehouse in 3D (Three.js) to locate products.
